title: Ghostwriter review reply (structured output)
description: Your review: every candidate answered once, kept or dropped, and your own suggestions.

items.description: A kept suggestion (with category), or a dropped candidate (finding and drop only).

notes.description: First, a few words for yourself on what you checked in context (the paragraph, its heading, the dates) before deciding. Never shown to the editor.

finding.description: The candidate this answers (f1, f2…). Leave out for your own suggestion.

drop.description: Only to drop a candidate: why it isn't a real problem here, in a few words. A dropped candidate has only notes, finding and drop.

unit.description: The unit (u3) or image (i2) the suggestion is in.

quote.description: The exact words changed, as the unit has them.

occurrence.description: 0 for the first time the quoted words appear in the unit, 1 for the second; only when they repeat.

reason.description: Why, in one or two sentences, for the editor.

heading.description: The voice guide's heading, exactly, for voice-guide.

alternatives.description: Up to two genuinely different versions.

ask.description: What to ask the editor, in a few words.

template.description: The quoted words with {answer} where the fact goes.

without.description: The quoted words without the fact, when they still work; null when they don't.
